new_comparator_acceptance.hard_bounds: Both S and L: V1080–1320V; Iphase/Ispace≤1500A; B0–100kJ; |b|/|u|≤450kW; actual declared slew; modulation/circular utilization≤1
new_comparator_acceptance.service_tracking: L tracks own non-service request; S tracks original request. Each20ms-cycle mean P/Q error≤2kW/10kvar, with matching command-window means
new_comparator_acceptance.return: Dense final100ms S−L max|ΔW|/|ΔB|≤2J; each max|Δi_phase|≤2A; diagnostic b/controller/duty/Z differences and individual final orbit periodicity
new_comparator_acceptance.recovery_budgets: FromT toT+.5: max paired |cP_S−cP_L|≤5000W, absolute net signed active energy≤100J, positive-only energy≤100J, absolute-integral energy≤100J
new_comparator_acceptance.numerics: Midpoint physical energy residual≤.1J; both integration resolutions retained; max cumulative S/L numerical load-energy discrepancy≤1e-5J, with exact input function equality separately established; workload integration must be clipped to0–.2s, not full .3s CSV
new_comparator_acceptance.identity: For signed every-window grossAC,copper,net-after-copper,load and stored-energy differences, S−F=(S−L)+(L−F), residual≤1e-8J up to floating cancellation. Do NOT subtract positive/absolute integrals linearly; recompute directly for each paired waveform

interpretation: All phase3 cells retrospective; no new blind robustness evidence. Original F/S cost over recovery[.2,.7] already has identical650kW input and remains valid baseline-orbit return cost with differing prehistories. New S/L holds whole time-resolved actual workload fixed and changes grid-service/buffer strategy versus a declared load-following counterfactual, not a uniquely causal universal service attribution. Original V2 claims/freeze not retroactively changed.
stop_rule: Preserve all old results and any new failure. No post-result controller, comparator, bounds or budget changes.
